trigger: Candidate-v5 failed frozen protected-validation retrieval-preservation guardrails.

observed_remaining_failure_mechanisms.description: High-overlap review/topic discourse with no answer-bearing value was accepted as evidence because residual non-query lexical tokens were treated as value candidates.

A valid answer proposition coexisted with same-subject/same-relation agenda/question discourse; the latter appears to have produced a spurious value proposition and therefore a false contradiction/abstention.

candidate_v6_design_direction.core_change: Replace generic token-residue value detection with explicit assertion-structure extraction. Evidence support requires a recognized assertion frame linking subject, predicate, and object/value; meta-discourse, questions, agenda/review text, and unresolved discussion cannot create object/value nodes.
preserve: Candidate-v2 frozen retrieval as a candidate baseline option
new_mechanisms_to_compare: deterministic clause-role parser with explicit meta-discourse classifier
hybrid deterministic parser plus frozen zero-cost local NLI only for unresolved assertion roles

research_integrity_rule: Candidate-v6 must have a new preregistration, new source/config identity, new development data, and fresh protected evidence. Candidate-v5 protected-validation cases may be used only as historical diagnostics, never as Candidate-v6 confirmatory selection data.
